text.p: Maccabi Tel Aviv reached the final 16 of the EuroLeague basketball competition after defeating Olympiakos 82-78 in a tight game on Thursday.
Maccabi's two foreign contract players, Randy White and Buck Johnson, were again top scorers for the Israeli champions with 24 and 22 points.

The Greeks were already assured of a place in the last 16, but it was a bad result for them. The defeat, coupled with Alba Berlin winning away in Italy at Stefanel Milan, means Olympiakos slip out of the top two in their group and if a third game is necessary against their final 16 opponent Olympiakos will be the away club.
Maccabi had guard Brad Leaf to thank for some fine shooting from the free-throw line on Thursday.
Leaf hit three with zero showing on the clock at the end of the first half to level the scores at 44-44. He was again instrumental at the very end of the game sinking two more vital throws.
Maccabi had managed to open up a nine-point lead with seven minutes remaining, only for the Greeks to level at 71-71.
But Maccabi, needing to win, battled back to keep their European hopes alive.
